neet_phy_u13_t05_1.working: The plane is parallel to B, so the normal is at 90° to B. τ = NIAB = 50×2×4×10⁻³×0.5 = 0.2 N m.

neet_phy_u13_t05_2.working: For wire length L, the circle has area L²/(4π) and the square has area L²/16. Maximum torque is proportional to area, so the ratio is (L²/(4π))/(L²/16) = 4/π.

neet_phy_u13_t05_4.working: Parallel: τ = 0, U = −mB. Antiparallel: τ = 0, U = +mB. Plane parallel to B (θ = 90°): τ = mB, U = 0. θ = 60°: τ = (√3/2)mB, U = −mB/2.

neet_phy_u13_t05_5.working: A is true: net force in a uniform field is zero. B is true: the formula holds for any planar shape. C is false: torque is maximum when the plane is parallel to B. D is true: the antiparallel position is an unstable equilibrium. E is false: U is minimum when the plane is perpendicular to B.
